file_info.description: Mode 2: Face Consistency - Preserves specific model identity using Master Image

prompts.subject_identity: A real-life model with the exact face of [MASTER_IMG].
prompts.face_consistency_rule: Meticulously lock facial features from [MASTER_IMG], including eye makeup, presence/depth of aegyosal (under-eye fat), forehead-to-chin ratio, eye shape, overall face shape, and cheek volume.
prompts.expression_mapping: Map the specific expression and emotional nuance (gaze, mouth angle, eye crinkle) from [REFERENCE_IMG] onto the face of [MASTER_IMG] without distorting the base facial structure.
